name: synthetic-fetch-cache-hit
description: SYNTHETIC cache-hit chain for clawifi#fetch: synthetic-fetch-ok with `cache_hit: true` and `credits_charged: 0` (a cached copy keeps its original mode_used and fetched_at). Clawifi charges 0 for a cache hit; the engine prunes the zero claim, so the derived fold must settle at 0 too.
